name: Portia Doubleday
bio: Portia Ann Doubleday (born June 22, 1988) is an American actress. She is best known for her role as Angela Moss in the TV series Mr. Robot, which ran from 2015 until 2019. She comes from a show business family, being the daughter of actor Frank Doubleday and actress Christina Hart. Her other more notable roles include the films Youth in Revolt, Her, Carrie, and Fantasy Island.
